Orchestrator handoff: per-phase dispatch spec, waves [[1],[2],[3]], zero-debt + full-CI gates

memory_candidates.content: When a completeness metatheorem is already parametrized over an abstract axiom set (as in the task-480 birelational intuitionistic modal framework's ivalid_completeness/mvalid_completeness), instantiating a concrete logic (IK) collapses completeness to a ONE-LINER: define the concrete axiom inductive, then apply the parametric theorem with one discharger lambda per framework hypothesis. The only genuinely new proof work is soundness for the new axioms. Plan such instantiation tasks as: (P1) axiom datatype, (P2) soundness, (P3) trivial completeness/consistency instantiation + barrel — not as a from-scratch completeness effort.
